DYNE-101 Update

 

On September 6, 2022, the Company announced the initiation of its Phase 1/2 clinical trial, ACHIEVE, evaluating DYNE-101 for the treatment of myotonic dystrophy type 1 (“DM1”). The first patient in the trial is expected to be dosed in September 2022.
 

The ACHIEVE trial is a Phase 1/2 global clinical trial evaluating DYNE-101, consisting of a 24-week MAD randomized placebo-controlled period, a 24-week open-label extension and a 96-week long-term extension. The trial, which is designed to be registrational, is expected to enroll approximately 64 adult patients with DM1 who are 18 to 49 years of age. The primary endpoints are safety and tolerability. Secondary endpoints include pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, including change from baseline in splicing, as well as measures of muscle strength and function. The Company anticipates reporting data from the MAD placebo-controlled portion of the ACHIEVE trial on safety, tolerability and splicing in the second half of 2023.
